logo_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a single refined original identity lockup for COIFFURE KARIM, a men's and children's hairdresser and barber in Pontchâteau, France. Output a genuine transparent-background PNG, wide horizontal 2:1 composition, generous clean negative space. The original design should pair an elegant compact custom K emblem on the left with the hand-lettered word "Karim" on the right, then a small widely tracked sans-serif line "COIFFURE & BARBIER" and below "PONTCHÂTEAU". Exact spelling, accents and no other text. The K emblem must be a very simple fluid ink drawing: one strong upright and two tapered hairlike diagonal strokes, with three small comb-like cuts only in the lower diagonal. It must look like a memorable K before the comb detail is noticed. Wordmark "Karim" is bespoke confident flowing ink calligraphy, subtly forward leaning with beautiful restrained stroke contrast, crisp silhouettes and short flourishes; the K of wordmark should relate to emblem. Contemporary French graphic design, premium independent atelier, warm expressive human touch, not ornate salon calligraphy. One solid deep petroleum ink color #172A36 throughout. Completely flat uniform fill, vector-friendly precise closed shapes, no texture on logo, no gradients, no bevel, no drop shadow, no 3D, no paper, no mockup, no visible checkerboard, no framing box. Transparent alpha everywhere outside ink. No scissors, moustache icon, barber pole, crown, laurel, blade, initials A, or stock circular badge. Do not imitate an existing business logo. Keep emblem and wordmark balanced and give the small French descriptor enough size to be readable. This is a brand proposal, not a redesign of signage.
selected_model_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / compositing.
Create a highly polished full-page desktop website art direction mockup for "Coiffure Karim", a men's and children's hairdresser and barber in Pontchâteau, France. Tall single-page canvas approximately 1024 x 2560 px, full-bleed flat website screenshot, not a device, no browser chrome or perspective.
Input Image 1 is the finished proposed brand logo, a deep petroleum custom K emblem with comb cuts and flowing Karim lettering: incorporate it faithfully into the header and footer. Input Image 2 is the STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: take its sophisticated interplay of natural photographic human detail, fine graphite sketching, energetic watercolor/ink gestures, sparse handwritten annotations and disciplined fine construction lines. Translate the visual grammar into hairdressing; never reproduce the chef, cooking clothing, food, kitchen tools or English copy.
Brand system shared across all concepts: petroleum ink #172A36, warm paper #F3EFE4, saffron #EBA247, teal #1D7F83, small coral #CE543A accents. Restrict noisy bright patches: premium considered art direction, adult masculine but warm, human, confident, French independent atelier. Hero and most sections use a rich image/art background with large beautifully readable text over it. Exactly one main section may be a single flat color; other areas use composed photography, pencil drawings, ink washes and texture. No conventional boxed cards or generic rounded SaaS section components. Every section divider must be designed specifically, with image layers continuing across the junction; not identical wave dividers on every row, not standard stacked rectangles, no scrapbook tape/stickers/polaroids.
Typography: premium characterful contemporary grotesque headlines reminiscent of Bricolage Grotesque, very clear refined humanist body copy like DM Sans; selected handwritten words in loose confident brush ink echoing the logo and reference. Careful tracking and fluent typography, not the condensed black/gold barber website cliché. Large typesetting with intentional line breaks, consistent baseline and generous visual breathing room. Text is FRENCH ONLY.
Header shows logo and short nav "Le geste", "Les coupes", "Nous trouver", CTA "Venir au salon". Contact copy, if used, must be exact: "14 rue Maurice Sambron", "44160 Pontchâteau", "07 58 12 73 70". Buttons only "Venir au salon", "Voir l’itinéraire", "Appeler". Services allowed: "Homme", "Enfant", "Barbe". No booking buttons, Planity logos, prices, reviews, stars, fake awards, years, testimonials, invented owner portrait labels, social follower counts, or grand claims.
All people and photographic scenes are original fictional campaign imagery. Do not pretend a generated man is Karim, an employee, or a real customer. No fabricated storefront or interior. Show exceptionally credible skin, hands, hair and correct tools, normal fully clothed clients, clean believable haircutting anatomy. Photos should feel premium editorial, then selectively transition into the hand-drawn illustration style of the reference.
Do not copy previous projects: no throne/chair hero, mural wall barber portrait, giant A letter, circular glowing halo, blonde woman, repeated black/gold layouts, empty dark backgrounds, template card grids.
The website should feel like an art-directed designed object with vivid image-led scenes, strong visual hierarchy and unexpected yet coherent section junctions. All headlines and contact details must be sharp and readable.
Add a very slim discrete proposal label above the site at the absolute top, to identify the model. No instruction text or animation notes embedded in the visitor page.

PROPOSAL LABEL "03 — LES LIGNES VIVANTES".
This is a cinematic, refined, graphic art direction based on continuous hair contours, panoramic photography and pencil. It must have FOUR very spacious distinct scenes instead of the five-scene structures of the other proposals.
1 HERO top 35%: one exceptionally natural adult male client photographed in three-quarter profile, 30s, short textured dark hair, natural beard and casual ivory shirt, face and hair beautifully defined. Photoreal portrait fills the RIGHT half with part of forehead/hair extending beyond frame. At left, warm paper and fine dynamic hair-strand graphite lines, restrained petrol watercolor and saffron undertone. Very large custom type "L’art" with the handwritten words "de la ligne." sweeping from left over the photographic shoulder. Small service line, understated outlined "Venir au salon →" button, elegant logo/header. One continuous graphite line travels from the logo area through the portrait's contour and bends into the boundary below. No glowing circle, no giant letter mask.
2 A panoramic campaign 'frieze' about 28%: three boldly interlocking photographic and drawn fields spanning full width with absolutely NO separated boxed tiles: a superb clean adult side-profile haircut on the left; fully clothed child with a neat normal haircut shown from the back in the middle; precise beard/comb macro on the right. Profile contour boundaries and graphic shutter slots, not equal rectangular columns. Photographic portions turn into sketch strokes at their edges, faint teal/saffron accents. Huge expressive white or petroleum overlaid words "Homme." "Enfant." "Barbe." Each lies directly on its respective continuous scene. Small center headline "Trois gestes." / handwritten "Une même attention." aligned in readable areas. The whole section is a single wide composed image environment; do not pretend this is a real client portfolio or before/after.
3 LOCATION about 18%: the ONLY solid-color main section, deep petroleum ink. Extreme typographic rhythm: huge slim saffron number "14" occupying the LEFT 40% with its 4 stroke carrying a fine comb motif, right ivory headline "Au cœur" / "de Pontchâteau." Then readable "14 rue Maurice Sambron", "44160 Pontchâteau", "07 58 12 73 70" and small outlined "Voir l’itinéraire →". No invented map, no storefront, no services repeated here. Lower edge has a high-precision stepped contour derived from the comb line, not a stock wave.
4 ENDING about 19%: spectacular full-bleed macro of real-feeling human hair being held between fingers before a scissor cut, softly directional photographic light with the edge becoming graphite on warm paper and a light teal wash. The continuous line from above finishes in the brand K, small in the lower corner. Bold headline "Le prochain trait," / handwritten "c’est le vôtre." The ink word "Karim" is large and elegant near the bottom, exact phone and an "Appeler →" control nearby. Plenty of legible negative space built into photographic framing. Footer integrated into this image, no additional flat bar.
Movement is implied by designed continuity and contour edges, not motion blur. Favor beautiful precise fluid contours and panoramic image over sticker-like collages. Give all four scenes generous height and sophisticated section connections.

masters.name: hero-art
masters.prompt:
Use case: compositing / campaign asset extraction.
The input image is the client-approved MODEL 3 website art direction for Coiffure Karim. Create a production background asset derived from the specified scene, not another website mockup. Preserve its natural photographic details meeting fine graphite pencil construction lines, confident hair contours, warm paper, teal/petroleum ink wash, saffron paint and sparse coral. The figures are fictional campaign subjects, not actual owner, staff or customer portraits. Exactly match the art direction and male hairstyle of the approved reference; do not change to a dark/gold traditional barbershop scene. Output a full rectangular background image with all title, logo, number, captions, labels, buttons, icons and UI completely absent. No letters or numerals anywhere, no watermark. Do not add interiors, furniture, building photographs, ratings or signage. Keep anatomical hands and professional tools exceptionally plausible. No face beautification plastic filter. Fine paper fibers and restrained painterly marks, not heavy poster grain.
Scene: the TOP HERO ONLY. A wide landscape approximately 1664x1088. The same curly dark-haired adult male client in three-quarter view facing right, short natural beard, cream casual shirt, visually impressive photographic face and curls with the shoulder and hair edges dissolving into the fine pencil lines from the concept. His head/shoulder fills the RIGHT 55% of the canvas, face around 75% across; preserve the large clear warm-paper negative space over the LEFT 43% for live text. Teal washes and saffron behind and outside hair, sketch lines joining neck and bottom edge. No comb/scissor hand in this scene. Slightly wider crop than the original vertical reference but keep the client dominant, no tiny head floating. Entire LEFT text zone must be light enough for deep petroleum text and contain only very faint pencil strokes. No visible page or section divider, no text remnants. Framing fills all edges, portrait may crop at right and lower shoulder.
